tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Searches the hotel catalogue. Accepts structured filters, a free-form natural-language `query` (the server extracts filters from it), or lat/lon/radius proximity — combinable; explicit structured filters override query-extracted ones. Returns previews with pagination and the effective filters used, so you can refine and re-issue. For area queries like "hotels in Soho", first call `geocode_location` to obtain a `geometryRef`, then pass it as `geometry` here. Use `pageToken` to fetch subsequent pages. Do not call `get_hotel` afterwards to enrich results — previews already contain `googlePlaceId`, `lat`, `lon`, and `address`.

city.description: City names. Multiple values are OR-combined.

hotelIdType.description: Hotel ID scope: `huId` for canonical id; a DsName (e.g. "GoogleHotels", "Booking"); or extra OTA slug.

hotelId.description: Specific hotel IDs to include or exclude (max 50). List scope and rich-content subscription filters use a separate unbounded path; see param notes in code.

hotelIdFilterMode.description: Whether `hotelId` is an inclusion or exclusion list. Default: include.

hasLocation.description: Only return hotels with a location.

hasFeatures.description: Only return hotels with at least one feature.

hasRating.description: Only return hotels with a rating.

hasRooms.description: Only return hotels with room data.

hasDirectWebsite.description: Only return hotels with direct website data.

directPricingOnly.description: When true, only return hotels that have a DirectPricing main ref.

richContentSubscribed.description: Rich-content subscription filter: true = subscribed only, false = not subscribed only. Omit to disable this filter.

pageToken.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call as `nextPageToken`.

lat.description: Latitude of the search location. Must be used with lon and radius.

lon.description: Longitude of the search location. Must be used with lat and radius.

radius.description: Radius of the search location in meters. Must be used with lat and lon.

geometry.description: Geometry reference as "{locationId}-{place_id}". Obtain values from the /geocode endpoint. Hotels within the polygon will be returned.

geometryMultiplier.description: Scale factor for the polygon area. 2 makes the area 2x bigger, 0.5 makes it 2x smaller. Only applies when geometry is provided.

query.description: Free-form description of the hotels you are looking for (e.g. "4-star resorts in Sicily with a pool"). The server extracts structured filters from it; any explicit filter parameters override the extracted ones.

limit.description: Maximum number of hotels to return for a proximity-only search (lat/lon/radius with no other filters). Defaults to 50. Ignored otherwise.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description:
IMPORTANT: Only call this for hotels the user explicitly wants details on. DO NOT call speculatively to enrich search results — `search_hotels` previews already contain `googlePlaceId`, `lat`, `lon`, and `address`, which are sufficient to render a map and link list. Each hotel counts against the trial quota (100 unique full profiles).

WHAT IT DOES: Gets the canonical profile for 1–25 hotels by Hotel Universe ID, optionally with photo galleries, guest reviews, an AI hotel summary, and an AI review summary via `include`. Returns full profiles when entitled; paid-tier orgs without a rich-content subscription for a hotel receive a preview instead. Sections the organisation's tier or the caller's permissions do not allow are omitted with a notice instead of failing the call.

include.description: Extra sections to return per hotel. The profile is always returned. `reviews` and `review_summary` require the reviews permission and a reviews-enabled tier; `ai_summary` is not available on the trial tier.

reviewLimit.description: Maximum reviews to return per hotel (default 20). Only with `include: ["reviews"]`.

reviewOffset.description: Number of reviews to skip from the start (default 0). Only with `include: ["reviews"]`.

reviewTopic.description: Optional free-text topic (e.g. "parking", "breakfast"); returns only reviews semantically relevant to it, ranked by relevance. Only with `include: ["reviews"]`.

refresh.description: Regenerate AI summaries, bypassing the cache (default false).

tools.name: find_competitors
tools.description: Find competitor hotels near a given hotel, ranked by similarity (best match first).

huId.description: Hotel Universe ID of the source hotel.

tools.name: geocode_location
tools.description: Resolve a free-text location (e.g. "Baker Street, London") into a `geometryRef`, centre coordinates, and a bounding box. Pass the returned `geometryRef` as `geometry` to `search_hotels` to constrain results to that polygon (the full polygon is held server-side — you do not need to inspect it), or use `lat`/`lon` with a `radius` for a circular search. Use `boundingBox` (south, north, west, east) to gauge how large the area is before deciding on `radius` or pagination.

tools.name: get_lists
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Reads the organisation's hotel lists. Without `listId`, pages through all lists (10 per page, filterable by creator). With `listId`, returns that list's metadata (including the saved search query for dynamic lists) plus any `include` sections: `hotels` (entries with previews, 10 per page via `page`), `stats` (matched / needs-review / unmatched counts), and `diff` (new hotels matching a dynamic list's saved query that are not yet in the list; empty for static lists).

listId.description: List ID. Omit to page through all lists owned by the organisation.

include.description: Extra sections to return. Only with `listId`.

page.description: Without `listId`: lists page. With `include: ["hotels"]`: entries page. Default 1.

createdBy.description: Filter lists by creator user ID. Only without `listId`.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Creates a hotel list from exactly one source: `hotelIds` (static list from specific huIds), `filters` (saved search — `mode` "dynamic" keeps it live, "static" freezes the current matches), or `includeLists`/`excludeLists` (static union-minus combination of existing lists). Entries populate asynchronously for the hotelIds and combine sources. The name is optional (the server generates one) — never block a save to ask for a name; suggest one and let the user rename later.

name.description: Optional list name. If omitted, the server generates one.

hotelIds.description: Source A: create a static list from these Hotel Universe IDs.

city.description: City names. Multiple values are OR-combined.

hotelIdType.description: Hotel ID scope: `huId` for canonical id; a DsName (e.g. "GoogleHotels", "Booking"); or extra OTA slug.

hotelId.description: Specific hotel IDs to include or exclude (max 50). List scope and rich-content subscription filters use a separate unbounded path; see param notes in code.

hotelIdFilterMode.description: Whether `hotelId` is an inclusion or exclusion list. Default: include.

hasLocation.description: Only return hotels with a location.

hasFeatures.description: Only return hotels with at least one feature.

hasRating.description: Only return hotels with a rating.

hasRooms.description: Only return hotels with room data.

hasDirectWebsite.description: Only return hotels with direct website data.

directPricingOnly.description: When true, only return hotels that have a DirectPricing main ref.

richContentSubscribed.description: Rich-content subscription filter: true = subscribed only, false = not subscribed only. Omit to disable this filter.

pageToken.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call as `nextPageToken`.

lat.description: Latitude of the search location. Must be used with lon and radius.

lon.description: Longitude of the search location. Must be used with lat and radius.

radius.description: Radius of the search location in meters. Must be used with lat and lon.

geometry.description: Geometry reference as "{locationId}-{place_id}". Obtain values from the /geocode endpoint. Hotels within the polygon will be returned.

geometryMultiplier.description: Scale factor for the polygon area. 2 makes the area 2x bigger, 0.5 makes it 2x smaller. Only applies when geometry is provided.

filters.description: Source B: save a search as a list (same shape as `search_hotels` input).

mode.description: Only with `filters`. "dynamic" (default) keeps the saved query live; "static" freezes the current matches.

includeLists.description: Source C: create a static list from the union of these list IDs…

excludeLists.description: …minus any entries in these list IDs. Only with `includeLists`.

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Modifies an existing list. `rename` (needs `name`); `make_static` clears a dynamic list's saved query — entries are kept but it stops auto-updating; `append_entries` adds hotels (needs `hotelIds`); `delete_entry` removes one entry (needs `entryId`); `delete` removes the list, its entries, and its exports — irreversible; only call after the user has explicitly confirmed. Do not `make_static` a dynamic list the user actively relies on without confirming.

hotelIds.description: Hotel Universe IDs to append. Required for `append_entries`.

tools.name: review_list_matches
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Resolves fuzzy-match candidates for list entries. `decision` "approve" confirms each entry resolves to the given huId; "reject" marks each pair as not a match. Use the needs-review entries from `get_lists` with `include: ["stats"]` to find candidates.

decision.description: Whether the given entry/huId pairs are correct matches.

entryId.description: List entry ID from the needs-review set.

huId.description: Hotel Universe ID this entry should resolve to.

tools.name: manage_exports
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Manages exports of a list. `list` shows the list's export jobs; `request` (needs `type`) creates a new export job; `download` (needs `exportId`) returns the download URL, or a processing/expired/error status when the export is not ready. Typical flow: request, then poll with download.

listId.description: List ID the exports belong to.

type.description: Export type: full, preview, reviews, or source_data. Required for `request`.

tools.name: get_metasearch_pricing
tools.description: Get live booking offers (price, provider, refundability) for a hotel on a given check-in date. Subject to per-org rate limits; orgs without a paid metasearch subscription get a lower free-tier limit.

hotelIdType.description: `huId` (canonical id) or `GoogleHotels` (main ref id for Google Hotels).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code: three uppercase letters (e.g. "GBP"). Default "GBP".

tools.name: get_direct_pricing
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Reads the org's Smart Feed direct-pricing data. With neither `huId` nor `batchId`: lists linked hotels (`enabledOnly`, `limit`, `offset`). With `huId`: returns that hotel's direct-pricing detail, plus stored per-check-in-date prices when `include: ["prices"]` is set (tune the range with `startDate`/`interval`/`nights`/`guests`). With `batchId`: polls an async price batch started by `manage_direct_pricing` action "refresh" for progress and completed per-date results. Do not pass both `huId` and `batchId`.

huId.description: Hotel Universe ID — hotel detail mode.

include.description: With `huId`: also return stored prices per check-in date.

batchId.description: Smart Feed batch id from `manage_direct_pricing` action "refresh" — poll mode.

enabledOnly.description: List mode: only hotels enabled by this client (default false).

startDate.description: Prices: first check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to today (UTC).

interval.description: Prices: number of consecutive check-in dates (default 180).

tools.name: manage_direct_pricing
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Manages the org's Smart Feed direct-pricing integration. `link` connects up to 100 hotels by `huIds`. `enable`/`disable` turn pricing on/off for `huIds` (max 100) OR a `listId` — never both; enabling incurs charges and disabling takes effect at the next billing cycle, so always confirm with the user before either. `pull` fetches fresh pricing now for one enabled hotel (`huId`). `refresh` starts an async re-crawl over a forward date range and returns a `batchId` to poll via `get_direct_pricing`.

huIds.description: Hotel Universe IDs. For `enable`/`disable` (alternative to `listId`) and `link`.

listId.description: For `enable`/`disable` instead of `huIds` — applies to all hotels in the list.

huId.description: Single Hotel Universe ID. Required for `pull`/`refresh`.

startDate.description: Refresh: first check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to today (UTC).

interval.description: Refresh: number of consecutive check-in dates (default 180).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Reads the current user's account context. `include` selects sections and defaults to `["profile","orgs"]`: `profile` is the authenticated user's profile; `orgs` lists the organisations they belong to, with tier and billing; `access_stats` returns access-log action counts for an organisation over a time range — it REQUIRES `startDate` and `endDate` (timestamps in ms) and defaults to the authenticated org unless `orgId` is set.

startDate.description: access_stats: start date, timestamp in ms. Required for `access_stats`.

endDate.description: access_stats: end date, timestamp in ms. Required for `access_stats`.

orgId.description: access_stats: organisation ID (defaults to the authenticated org).

tools.name: manage_organization
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Manages the current organisation, its members, and its invitations. `create` makes a new org owned by the user (needs `name`); `rename` renames the current org (needs `name`); `delete` permanently removes the current org — irreversible, and the user must restate the exact org name in `confirmOrganizationName` or the call is rejected. `get_members` lists members; `remove_member` removes one by `memberId`; `add_subscribed_hotels` subscribes `huIds`. `list_invitations` lists pending invites; `invite` invites someone by `email`; `accept_invitation` accepts an invite by `id`; `cancel_invitation` cancels a pending invite by `id`. Confirm destructive or money-adjacent actions (delete, remove_member, invite) with the user before calling.

confirmOrganizationName.description: The exact current organisation name, restated by the user to confirm deletion. Required for `delete`.

memberId.description: User ID of the member to remove. Required for `remove_member`.

huIds.description: Hotel Universe IDs to subscribe. Required for `add_subscribed_hotels`.

email.description: Email address to invite. Required for `invite`.

tools.name: manage_access_tokens
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Manages the current organisation's API access tokens (PATs). `list` returns all tokens (secrets are never included). `create` issues a new token (needs `name`) and returns its `secret` ONLY in that response — surface it to the user once and warn it cannot be retrieved again. `rename` renames a token (needs `id` and `name`). `delete` revokes a token by `id` — irreversible. Confirm `create` and `delete` with the user before calling.

id.description: Access token ID. Required for `rename` and `delete`.

tools.name: get_billing
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Reads the current organisation's billing. `include` selects sections and defaults to `["subscription"]`: `subscription` returns billing, access tier, subscriptions, and usage; `plans` returns the tiers and limits available for a product and REQUIRES `product`; `invoices` lists invoices, optionally filtered by subscription `group`.

group.description: invoices: optional billing subscription group filter.

tools.name: manage_billing
tools.description: WHAT IT DOES: Changes the current organisation's billing. `checkout` creates a Stripe Checkout session for a `product`+`tier` and returns a URL the user must open to pay. `change_tier` upgrades/downgrades a `product` to a different `tier` (prorated, renewal date preserved). `cancel` schedules a `product` subscription to cancel at period end; `reactivate` undoes a scheduled cancellation. `management_portal` returns a Stripe Customer Portal URL for self-service. Every action changes what the org is billed — always confirm product and tier with the user before calling.

product.description: Billing product. Required for all actions except `management_portal`.

tools.name: product_support
tools.description: Look up Hotel Universe product knowledge to answer questions about the portal, the user's account/access/billing, plans, or how to complete a task. Call this BEFORE answering any product-support question, then answer from what it returns. Takes no arguments.
